title: Almifonis me los / Rosa sine culpe (anonymous, Ivrea Codex)
desc: Anonymous, Almifonis me los / Rosa sine culpe. 3 voices (Triplum, Motetus, Tenor), each on its own staff. Transcribed from the original mensural notation at the original pitch; note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), a perfect value written with a dot. The tenor is a chant melody laid out in a repeated rhythm.
cr: From Measuring Polyphony (measuringpolyphony.org, ed. Karen Desmond). Licence: CC BY 3.0.

poly.lyr: Al- mi- fo- nis me los cum vo- ci- bus ma- trem . Chri- sti, cum mul- ti- pli- ci- bus, . o- ya- do- ni de- cem ge- ne- ri- bus . nunc psal- le- re, . cu- ius plu- res vo- lunt as- . se- re- re cor- pus al- mum re- di- gi ci- ne- re, . ho- rum tu- um fa- te- . or cre- de- re con- tra- ri- um Nam . mun- da- vit . i- stam fla- men . . pi- um, quid in- . . . te- . grum ma- trem et fi- li- um . es- se fe- cit, quod nul- lum vi- ci- um non se- gre- gat Er- . go ci- nis i- stos no dis- gre- gat quos spi- ri- . tus sanct- us sic a- gre- gat, hoc u- ni- o . car- . . nis non de- ne- gat. . Hinc no- vi- sti, nam de car- ne ma- tris . ca- ro Chri- sti, sed reg- nan- tem ce- li hunc au- di- sti. Er- go ma- ter se- cum de- bet . si- . . sti. Mox le- gi- tur quod de- fun- cta vir- go . se- pre- li- tur, sed in ter- ris nus- quam re- pe- ri- tur, . quo sic ra- ptum cor- pus hoc ve- sci- tur mul- ti po- lo. Hoc cre- de- re sem- per vo- lo, nam si pars . es- set in so- lo cum . ver- mi- bus at- que pars cum ce- le- sti- bus . glo- ri- fi- ca- ta ci- vi- bus, va- ne pi- a to- ta . re- ple- ta gra- ti- a di- ca- tur vir- go Ma- ri- a, . sed . est to- ta ple- na, pul- chra, fe- ce lo- ta. . Er- go non est ver- mi no- . . . ta . ve- lut ling- na ca- ro tu- a; vir- go di- gna de- fen- de- ris no- bis si- gna, O dul- cis, O pi- a, O be- ni- gna.

Ro- . sa si- ne cul- pe spi- . . . na . per quam pa- tet lex di- vi- na, . stel- la Ma- . . ri- a ma- ris, . mun- di sa- lus . et re- gi- na, . . . . mun- . . . . . dum . mun- dans a sen- ti- . na, . sy- dus jam . so- . lem . pa- . . . . . ris; . stel- la ru- bens . . . . ma- tu- ti- na vi- a vi- te me- di- ci- na, . por- tus- que sa- lu- . ta- . ris, . au- rem no- bis hunc in- cli- na . ut . nos . . . ser- . ves a ru- i- na . pa- rens et . ex- . . . pers . pa- . . ris . Re- ve- la- trix pau- . pe- rum, . su- pe- ra- trix o- ne- rum at- que sor- . dis ve- . te- rum . me- . di- . ca- trix vul- . . ne- rum au- ge, pi- a, . . mu- . ne- rum . ac . vir- tu- tum nu- me- rum, ro- gans re- gem . . . . pe- rum . ne nos pre- mat . i- te- rum fe- da mo- les sce- le- rum.
